# Palanor MCP tools: arguments

<!-- Generated by skills/palanor/tools/build.py from skills/palanor/source. Do not edit by hand. -->

The tools this skill uses, with every argument as the server declares it (tools/list on https://mcp.palanor.com, captured 2026-11-18). The server's own list is the authority: if a call is refused for an argument, read the tool's schema from your client.

## palanor_search_signals

Find signals in the Palanor lattice by meaning and keywords, e.g. "yield curve", "used car prices", "Canada unemployment". Returns only signals the API serves, each with its slug, latest value and source, so every slug works in palanor_get_signal and palanor_get_observations.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | string | yes | What to look for (two characters or more). |
| `limit` | number | no | Results, 1–50 (default 10). |

## palanor_list_signals

List or search signals in the Palanor lattice — the unified map of every data source Palanor reads (FRED macro series, commodities, prediction markets, survey indices, Custom Indices). In Palanor, everything is a signal. Pass `query` to search by meaning and name ("are households falling behind", "UNRATE", "propane demand"); results come back most relevant first. Without `query`, signals are listed by slug and can be paged with `offset`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Optional natural-language question, theme, name or identifier. Ranks results by relevance. |
| `category` | string | no | Optional category filter (e.g. macro, labor, rates, energy, sentiment). |
| `geo` | string | no | Optional geography: an ISO3 country code (USA, CAN, GBR, BRA) or a region (world, north-america, latam, europe, eu, euro-area, asia-pacific, mena, sub-saharan-africa, africa, asia, oceania, g7, g20, oecd). Comma-separate several. A region includes its countries; world means signals that measure the whole world. |
| `limit` | number | no | Max rows, 1–200 (default 50). |
| `offset` | number | no | Rows to skip when listing without a query (default 0). |

## palanor_get_signal

Get one signal's metadata, its latest value, where that value stands in the signal's own record (percentile, record high/low, highest/lowest since, 30/90/365-day change, moving averages, z-scores, and a plain-language read), and optionally recent history, from the Palanor lattice.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Signal slug (from palanor_list_signals). |
| `history` | boolean | no | Include ~90 recent observations (default false). |
| `vintage` | string | no | latest (default): values as revised today. first: each observation as first published, before revisions (for major macro releases; available only where licensed for redistribution). One of: `latest`, `first`. |

## palanor_get_latest

The latest reading of up to 100 signals in one call, each with its provenance. A slug the API does not serve comes back with an error instead of a value. Costs one request per ten slugs, rounded up.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slugs` | array of string | yes | Signal slugs. |

## palanor_get_observations

A signal's observations between two dates from the Palanor lattice, oldest first, up to 1,000 per call (page with `offset` while `pagination.has_more`). Use it for a series over a set window, e.g. the 2y10y Treasury spread since 2020; palanor_get_signal gives the latest value and its context. Every result carries the provenance block of the signal's source.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Signal slug (from palanor_list_signals). |
| `start` | string | no | Optional YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. |
| `end` | string | no | Optional YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. |
| `order` | string | no | asc (default) or desc. One of: `asc`, `desc`. |
| `limit` | number | no | Rows, 1–1000 (default 500). |
| `offset` | number | no | Rows to skip (default 0). |
| `vintage` | string | no | latest (default): values as revised today. first: each observation as first published (available only where licensed for redistribution). One of: `latest`, `first`. |
| `freq` | string | no | Optional: one value per period, dated the period's last day. Omit for every observation. One of: `week`, `month`, `quarter`, `year`. |
| `agg` | string | no | How a period becomes one value (default last: the closing reading). One of: `last`, `first`, `mean`, `sum`, `min`, `max`. |

## palanor_list_indices

List Palanor Custom Indices — named, narrated composite indicators authored by Palanor (e.g. The Palanor Index, Capital Tightness). Each returns a live value and a published methodology page.

No arguments.

## palanor_get_index

Get one Palanor Custom Index in full — live value, component breakdown, and methodology. Palanor shows its work: the reasoning ships with the number.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Index slug, with or without the palanor_ prefix (e.g. capital_tightness). |

## palanor_list_currents

List Currents — the world's named macro motions measured by Palanor (Reshoring, AI Margin Compression, The Capital Window). Each carries three reads: Momentum (direction + velocity), Belief (who has bought in), Maturity.

No arguments.

## palanor_get_current

Get one Current's live Momentum / Belief / Maturity reads and its brand phrase.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Current slug (from palanor_list_currents). |

## palanor_create_chart

Render a Palanor Studio chart (PNG) of 1–4 public signals — the same brand-locked chart, verification and licence checks the Studio uses. Asynchronous: returns a job id; call palanor_get_chart until status is "done" (typically under a minute), then use the image URL. Numbers are never typed: omit `claim` for a default, or write one with tokens such as "{{a.last|1}}" (a = first signal, b = second…; also .first, .min, .max, .change, .as_of, .first_x, .last_x). A digit written into `claim` fails verification. Only redistributable signals chart; market prices (equities, ETFs, crypto, FX) do not. Allowance: Free 10 a month, Pro 25 a day, Enterprise 200 a day.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signals` | array of object | yes | Signals to plot, in order (a, b, c, d). Each item: `slug`; `label`; `transform` (`level`, `change_since`, `pct_change_since`, `index_100`, `yoy_pct`, `yoy_change`, `growth_10k`, `compound_10k`, `sum_12m`, `hours_to_minutes`, `minutes_to_hours`, `running_max`, `running_mean`, `period_change`); `agg` (`raw`, `weekly_last`, `weekly_mean`, `monthly_mean`, `monthly_last`, `quarterly_mean`, `quarterly_last`, `yearly_mean`, `yearly_last`, `yearly_sum`); `decimals`. |
| `from` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD. Default five years back. |
| `to` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD. Default latest. |
| `kind` | string | no | One of: `line`, `change_since_line`, `small_multiples`. |
| `claim` | string | no | The headline sentence, numbers as tokens only. |
| `does_not_say` | string | no | Finishes "What it does not say: …". |
| `formats` | array of string | no | single (default) and/or square. |

## palanor_get_chart

Status of a chart started with palanor_create_chart; checking does not count against your monthly requests. When status is "done" it returns the PNG URL(s), the resolved headline, the licence attribution lines to print with it, and the values charted.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Job id from palanor_create_chart. |

## palanor_get_embed_code

Get the embed code for a live Palanor chart of one signal or Custom Index: an iframe that renders the series with its source line, license and a link back to its methodology page. Use it when a user wants to put a Palanor chart on a web page, blog post or dashboard. Only charts whose data may be redistributed embed (public-domain and openly licensed sources, Palanor-derived series, public Custom Indices); market prices never do, and the result says why when a chart cannot be embedded.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signal` | string | no | Signal slug (e.g. rates.spread_2y10y). Pass this or `index`. |
| `index` | string | no | Custom Index slug, with or without the palanor_ prefix (e.g. consumer_health). |
| `range` | string | no | Time window shown (default 5y). One of: `1y`, `2y`, `5y`, `10y`, `max`. |
| `theme` | string | no | Colour theme; auto follows the reader's setting (default). One of: `auto`, `light`, `dark`. |

## palanor_get_foresight

Palanor Foresight™ for one signal: the projected value at a horizon with a band that holds about two in three outcomes, and the projected path. The horizon depends on the series: 30 days for daily to monthly data, 1 year for quarterly, 3 years for annual. `method` is the disclosure printed under Palanor charts: the blend and the related signals it reads. A source's own published forecast is not projected again. Pro and Enterprise keys. Requires a Pro or Enterprise key.

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Signal slug (from palanor_search_signals or palanor_list_signals). |
| `horizon` | string | no | Optional: days ("30"), a span ("30d", "12w", "6m", "1y") or a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the full horizon. |
| `path` | boolean | no | Include the whole projected path (default false: the value at the horizon only). |

## The server's other tools

Not covered by this skill's workflows, but on the same server and the same key. Read each tool's description before calling it; tools marked Pro or Enterprise refuse a Free key.

- `palanor_get_risk_factor_changes`: How S&P 500 companies' 10-K risk factors changed year over year.
- `palanor_wire` (Pro or Enterprise): Query the Palanor Wire — primary-source market and economic items normalized into one importance-scored feed.
- `palanor_get_guidance`: Read the Palanor Guidance Ledger — quantitative forward guidance (revenue, EPS, margins, capex, FCF…) from S&P 500 8-K earnings releases.
- `palanor_get_kpis`: Read the Palanor KPI Ledger — company-reported operating metrics (subscribers, net adds, same-store sales, backlog, bookings, RPO, net revenue retention, ARPU, deliveries, production, occupancy, RevPAR, load factor, unit revenue and cost…) from S&P 500 8-K earnings releases, for the period each release reports.
- `palanor_get_form_d_offerings` (Pro or Enterprise): U.S.
- `palanor_get_form_d_issuer` (Pro or Enterprise): One Form D issuer by CIK: its offerings (latest filing each), every Form D and D/A it filed with the amount each added, and Palanor's AI classification with method, confidence, a one-line description of what the company does and the evidence URL.
- `palanor_get_ai_venture_share`: The AI share of U.S.
- `palanor_get_advisers` (Pro or Enterprise): U.S.
- `palanor_get_adviser` (Pro or Enterprise): One investment adviser by CRD number: its latest Form ADV answers from the SEC lists, its private funds from Form ADV Schedule D (type, gross asset value, beneficial owners, auditors), and the Form D offerings of those funds.
- `palanor_get_private_funds` (Pro or Enterprise): U.S.-adviser private funds from Form ADV Schedule D 7.B.(1) (SEC Form ADV data: FOIA files through 2024, adviserinfo.sec.gov monthly files after, filings through September 2026): fund ID, name, type (hedge, private equity, venture capital, real estate, securitized, liquidity, other), gross asset value, beneficial owners, minimum investment, auditors and Big Four flag, Form D file numbers, adviser CRD.
- `palanor_get_private_fund_stats`: Private fund aggregates: Palanor's Form ADV Schedule D totals by fiscal year and fund type (fund count, gross assets, median fund size, beneficial owners, Big Four auditor share, 2012 onward), and the SEC's quarterly Private Fund Statistics from Form PF (fund counts, gross and net assets, borrowings as a share of gross assets, 2013 onward).
- `palanor_get_deals` (Pro or Enterprise): Deal filings by every SEC registrant, newest first: 8-K Item 1.01 (material definitive agreement, including merger agreements), 8-K Item 2.01 (completed acquisition or disposition), Schedule TO-T (third-party tender offer) and Schedule 13E-3 (going-private transaction).
- `palanor_find_entities` (Pro or Enterprise): Find companies, funds and advisers in the Palanor company graph, which joins SEC CIK, ticker, GLEIF LEI, Wikidata QID, Form ADV CRD, USAspending UEI, Companies House number and USPTO assignee into one entity per legal entity.
- `palanor_get_entity` (Pro or Enterprise): One entity in the Palanor company graph by any identifier (cik:…, lei:…, ticker:…, crd:…, uei:…, qid:Q…, gb_ch:…): its attributes, every identifier with the source, method, confidence and evidence of the match, candidate matches Palanor did not merge, and its ownership tree from GLEIF Level 2 (parents up to the ultimate parent, children, fund manager and umbrella links).
- `palanor_ownership`: Who owns a U.S.
- `palanor_insider_transactions`: A company's insider transactions from SEC Forms 3, 4 and 5: insider, role, date, transaction code (P open-market purchase, S sale, A award, M exercise, F tax withholding …), shares, price, holdings after, direct/indirect, and the Rule 10b5-1 plan flag, each with its filing URL.
- `palanor_executive_pay`: A company's CEO and executive pay versus performance by fiscal year, from the XBRL-tagged pay-versus-performance table in its SEC proxy statements (DEF 14A): CEO total pay (Summary Compensation Table), compensation actually paid, other executives' averages, total shareholder return, peer TSR and net income.
- `palanor_fails_to_deliver`: A company's SEC fails-to-deliver record: daily aggregate settlement-fail balances, whether a persistent streak (5+ consecutive settlement days) is running, and the latest fail as a share of shares outstanding.
- `palanor_company_contracts`: Federal prime contracts (or grants) to one company in the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000 and S&P MidCap 400 from USAspending.gov, matched by parent recipient: monthly obligations, top awarding agencies over the trailing year, and new awards of $10M or more.
- `palanor_company_lobbying`: Federal lobbying by one company in the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000 and S&P MidCap 400 from Lobbying Disclosure Act filings (LDA.gov): quarterly spend, the general issues lobbied, outside firms, and lobbyists who previously held covered government positions (the revolving door).
- `palanor_company_patents`: U.S.
- `palanor_congress_holdings`: What members of Congress hold, from their e-filed annual financial disclosure reports (2016 on), as aggregates.
- `palanor_company_pacs`: A company's corporate PAC(s) from FEC filings, committee level only: per two-year cycle, receipts, disbursements, contributions to federal candidates (split by the candidate's party), to party committees and to other committees, and cash on hand, plus the largest candidate recipients in the latest cycle.
- `palanor_release_calendar`: The US economic release calendar: when BLS, BEA, Census, the Federal Reserve Board (FOMC, G.17, G.19, H.8, H.15), EIA, DOL and the Treasury (coupon auctions) publish, taken from each agency's own schedule.
- `palanor_get_industry`: The size of a US industry by NAICS code, as published by the Census Bureau (Economic Census receipts, County Business Patterns, Quarterly Services Survey revenue, Monthly and Annual Retail Trade sales), BEA (GDP by Industry value added) and BLS (QCEW private employment, establishments and wages).
- `palanor_corporate_events`: Material corporate events from SEC Form 8-K filings, by item code: cybersecurity incidents (1.05), restatements / non-reliance (4.02), auditor changes (4.01), bankruptcy (1.03), completed acquisitions or sales (2.01), restructuring costs (2.05), impairments (2.06), delisting notices (3.01), material agreements (1.01/1.02), director and officer changes (5.02, with the people and roles named where the filing states them) and shareholder votes (5.07).
- `palanor_layoff_tracker`: WARN Act notices (employer, place, workers, notice date, effective date, layoff or closure, the state's source) from the U.S.
- `palanor_tracker`: Palanor Trackers: event records from public filings.
- `palanor_company_attention`: How much the public is looking at a company in the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000 and S&P MidCap 400: daily views of its English Wikipedia article (Wikimedia, user agents), matched through Wikidata by SEC CIK or ticker.
- `palanor_company_hiring`: Hiring filings for one company in the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000 and S&P MidCap 400 from U.S.
- `palanor_get_global_yields`: Government bond yields across ~40 economies in one call: the latest 10-year yield per country (daily for the UK, Japan and Australia from the Bank of England, Japan's Ministry of Finance and the RBA; monthly averages from the OECD elsewhere), a short tenor where published, the change over a year, and derived spreads (Italy–Germany, France–Germany, Japan and Australia 2s10s, the median across 23 advanced economies).
- `palanor_get_commodity_prices`: World Bank monthly commodity prices (the Pink Sheet, CC BY 4.0): 44 commodities (energy, cocoa and coffee, vegetable oils, rice, sugar, meat, cotton, rubber, fertilizers, aluminium, iron ore, tin, gold, platinum …) and the 9 World Bank price indices (2010 = 100).
- `palanor_get_world_share_prices`: Stock markets around the world in one call: the OECD monthly share price index (2015 = 100, CC BY 4.0) for 47 economies and the euro area with its change over a year (local currency, price only), plus Palanor's daily composites of every company listed in Taiwan (cap-weighted from the Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taipei Exchange open data, 21 Oct 2026 = 100) once published.
- `palanor_list_screens`: The saved Entity Screener screens this key's owner can run: their own, those shared with their organization, and Palanor's house screens.
- `palanor_run_screen` (Pro or Enterprise): Run a saved Entity Screener screen (companies, investors, funds or deals from SEC Form D, EDGAR, Form ADV, USPTO and USAspending) with its saved filters and columns.
- `palanor_search_documents`: Search SEC filings and Federal Reserve publications by meaning and get the matching passages, verbatim: S&P 500 earnings releases (8-K Exhibit 99), 10-K Item 1A risk factors, 10-Q Item 2 MD&A, other 8-K exhibits, the Beige Book, FOMC statements and minutes, and Fed speeches.
- `palanor_news_search`: Search the Palanor Wire: stories Palanor's AI newsroom wrote and checked (Flash, Developing, Daily, Deep and From the record), newest first, with each story's tier, byline, Story Standard total, outlet count and corrections.
- `palanor_news_get`: One Palanor Wire story by id or slug: with Pro, the full text (markdown with [n] footnotes into its sources), the outlets and primary records that confirmed it (publisher and link only), Palanor readings behind it, entities, Story Standard grades, corrections, timeline and what to watch.
- `palanor_news_events` (Pro or Enterprise): Story clusters in Palanor’s newsroom, published or not: heat, tier, outlet counts, first and last seen, entities and linked signals, with Palanor’s headline when a story was published and the sources by publisher and link only.
- `palanor_org_news`: Your organization's ranked news (headless Context News): each item's score and why, its watchlist matches and priority source, Palanor's note for your organization, the publisher and link (headline where the publisher allows it), and Palanor's own story on it.
- `palanor_org_edition`: Your organization's morning edition through the news API: the lead, every item with its "For <Org>" note and links to your scenarios, Futures and signals, the editor's note, and that day's CompanyCast episode (audio links signed for an hour).
- `palanor_get_edition`: Your organization's morning edition: the masthead, the editor's note, each story's headline, link and outlet credit, the "For <Org>" note, linked scenarios by name and public signals, and what could not be confirmed.
